articles.summary: NVIDIA publicly used AfterQuery’s Off-The-Shelf Office Agent Training Dataset to improve Nemotron 3 Ultra on GDPval — the only data vendor named in their technical report, worth 11.4 GDPval points in their warmup ablation.
articles.title: How AfterQuery Helped NVIDIA Hill-Climb GDPval

articles.summary: Using fewer than 250 tasks from AfterQuery’s off-the-shelf data, on-policy distillation and PivotRL raised Qwen3.5-9B’s τ³-Banking pass@5 from 11.3% to 17.5%.
articles.title: Improving Qwen3.5-9B on τ³-Banking using PivotRL and fewer than 250 tasks
